svg.title: Blindspot AI
svg.desc: Blindspot AI — hackathon · team project. Reviews decision documents through six adversarial agents and a moderator, tracks blind spots across revisions and answers grounded follow-up questions. Pipeline: document → structured analysis → 6-agent debate → knowledge graph → grounded chat. Built with FastAPI, Pydantic, React 19, TypeScript, Groq.
